Testing a Markdown Pipeline

A conversion pipeline needs examples that stay stable over time. Fixed fixtures let contributors reproduce parsing bugs without relying on a remote page whose markup may change tomorrow.

A small parser

The following function trims a document title and supplies a fallback. The code fence should preserve both the language and every line break. 

export function cleanTitle(value: string): string {
  const title = value.trim();
  return title || 'Untitled';
}

console.log(cleanTitle('  Clip2MD  '));

Tests should also cover inline code such as npm run build, nested lists, quotes, and documents whose optional metadata is absent.

  • Conversion
    • Headings
    • Code fences
  • Downloads

With a focused suite, a failed assertion points to a real regression instead of an unexpected edit made by a website operator.
